title: West Indies Set to Host Two India T20Is in the US or Canada in 2027
excerpt: Two matches at one North American venue — Washington DC and Toronto are the frontrunners — are planned inside a July 2027 all-format tour, as Cricket West Indies pushes into the diaspora market.
body:
• West Indies are set to host two T20 internationals against India at a single venue in the United States or Canada in 2027, according to ESPNcricinfo — Washington DC and Toronto loom as the frontrunners.
  • The matches would form part of a July 2027 all-format India tour likely to consist of two Tests, three ODIs and five T20Is, under the 2027-31 Future Tours Programme, which is currently being finalised.
  • Nothing is confirmed yet: no dates, no chosen country, no venue and no tickets. Cricket West Indies says discussions are under way, driven by the large Caribbean and Indian diaspora in North America.

India's cricketers could be playing T20 internationals in North America next year — not as visitors to a US or Canadian home series, but as the away side in a West Indies home series staged across the Atlantic. According to ESPNcricinfo, West Indies are set to host T20Is against India in the USA or Canada in 2027, with two of the T20Is played in North America and both matches held at the same venue.

The tour taking shape

West Indies will start the next FTP cycle by hosting India in July 2027 for an all-format tour likely to consist of two Tests, three ODIs and five T20Is. The Future Tours Programme for 2027-31 is currently being finalised, with Full Members ironing out details at the ICC's quarterly meetings just held in Bali — so the North America plan sits inside a schedule that has not yet been published. There are currently no plans for West Indies to host a Test match in North America; the focus is on white-ball cricket, mainly T20Is.

Washington DC and Toronto lead the venue race

Washington DC, Los Angeles and Toronto are among the possible venues, ESPNcricinfo reports, with Washington DC and Toronto looming as the frontrunners. Also in the mix are Pomona — cricket's venue for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics — and Lauderhill, Florida, whose Broward County Stadium has regularly hosted West Indies games over the past decade. In the Washington area, Major League Cricket franchise Washington Freedom have started development on a 10,000-seat ground in Frederick, about 45 miles north of Washington DC, are expected to host games in the 2027 MLC season, and are working towards a strategic partnership with Cricket West Indies (CWI). Oakland Coliseum, which has hosted MLC games over the past two seasons, and Vancouver could also be on the cards in the future, though not for this series.

"It is really part of our strategy to expand in North America. I think that is critical for us and for cricket."

— Kishore Shallow, Cricket West Indies chair, to ESPNcricinfo

Why North America

CWI is the only Full Member in the region and is deepening its footprint in North America. Shallow pointed to the ICC's investment in the US, the T20 World Cup played there and the coming Olympics, alongside the region's significant Caribbean and Indian diaspora. "So that's why we are having discussions over hosting matches there," he told Cricinfo. CWI has also strengthened its relationship with Cricket Canada through the GT20 Canada, whose recently completed season was held entirely in St Vincent and the Grenadines.

What to watch next

For diaspora fans in the US and Canada, the practical questions are all still open: which country and venue win the two matches, the exact July dates, and when tickets might follow. None of that has been announced, and the FTP itself remains under negotiation. Further out, ESPNcricinfo reports West Indies' next-cycle highlights include hosting Australia later in the cycle and a 2028 Test tour of England featuring a match at Lord's to honour 100 years since West Indies' first Test — also at Lord's, in June 1928. The confirmed fixture list, when the FTP is published, will settle whether the North America T20Is survive in their current form.
nri_angle: Two India T20Is on US or Canadian soil would put the Indian team within reach of the large Indian and Caribbean diaspora crowds in cities like Toronto and Washington DC.
